title: Psoriasis, eczema and autoimmune blistering disease

steps.tx: Psoriasis is a chronic, relapsing **papulosquamous** eruption affecting about two percent of adults, with sharply demarcated plaques coated by silvery scale. Eczema is a common **spongiotic** dermatitis with intense itch affecting ten percent of children. Autoimmune blistering disease includes pemphigus vulgaris at one point nine per million, where **acantholysis** splits the epidermis.
steps.say: Psoriasis is a chronic relapsing papulosquamous rash affecting about two percent of adults, with sharply marked plaques covered in silver scale. Eczema is a very common itchy spongiotic rash affecting about ten percent of children. Autoimmune blistering disease includes pemphigus vulgaris at about two cases per million, where acantholysis splits the epidermis.

steps.tx: Psoriasis follows **polygenic** inheritance with sixty percent concordance in identical twins and strong links to HLA Cw six plus streptococcal pharyngitis triggers. Eczema risks include filaggrin mutations in thirty percent of atopic cases plus parental atopy. Pemphigus vulgaris is driven by anti desmoglein **IgG** antibodies of subclasses IgG one and IgG four in eighty percent of cases.
steps.say: Psoriasis is polygenic with about sixty percent concordance in identical twins and a strong link to HLA C w six plus streptococcal throat infection as a trigger. Eczema risks are linked to filaggrin mutations in about thirty percent of atopic cases plus parental atopy. Pemphigus vulgaris is driven by anti desmoglein IgG antibodies in about eighty percent of cases.

steps.tx: T cell **Th seventeen** immunity releases interleukin seventeen, interleukin twenty-three and tumour necrosis factor alpha, driving keratinocyte hyperproliferation with epidermal turnover shortened from twenty-eight days to four days. Filaggrin loss increases **transepidermal water loss** and allergen entry. Anti desmoglein IgG blocks cadherin adhesion so suprabasal cells detach, producing the **Nikolsky sign** on gentle traction.
steps.say: T cell Th seventeen immunity releases interleukin seventeen, interleukin twenty three and tumour necrosis factor alpha, driving fast skin cell growth with epidermal turnover shortened from twenty eight days to four days. Filaggrin loss increases water loss and allergen entry. Anti desmoglein IgG blocks adhesion so cells detach and produce the Nikolsky sign.

steps.tx: Chronic plaque psoriasis shows **extensor** plaques over elbows, knees and scalp with candle wax phenomenon, Auspitz sign of spot bleeding on scale removal and Woronoff ring at the edge. Guttate lesions follow streptococcal infection in fifty percent of children. Eczema presents with **flexural** lichenified itch, excoriations and sleep loss.
steps.say: Chronic plaque psoriasis shows extensor plaques over elbows, knees and scalp, with candle wax phenomenon, Auspitz sign of spot bleeding on scale removal and Woronoff ring at the edge. Guttate lesions follow streptococcal infection in about half of children. Eczema presents with flexural lichenified itch, excoriations and sleep loss.

steps.tx: Pemphigus vulgaris begins as flaccid oral bullae in sixty percent of cases, then ruptured **epithelial** erosions with base signs and raw beef red lesions. Bullous pemphigoid affects older patients with tense **subepidermal** bullae over flexures and spares mucosa. Dermatitis herpetiformis gives intensely itchy grouped vesicles with excoriated papules over extensor surfaces.

steps.tx: First test is **skin biopsy** with histopathology showing parakeratosis, microabscesses and acantholytic cells. Gold standard is **direct immunofluorescence** showing fishnet IgG in pemphigus and linear IgG at the basement membrane in bullous pemphigoid. ELISA detects anti desmoglein three antibodies in ninety percent of pemphigus vulgaris cases.

steps.tx: Limited psoriasis plaque responds to daily **potent corticosteroid** ointment zero point one percent betamethasone plus vitamin D analogue calcipotriol fifty mcg per gram twice daily for four weeks. Eczema needs liberal emollients two hundred fifty to five hundred g per week plus moderate potency **steroid** for flares. Pemphigus starts with systemic corticosteroid one mg per kg daily for two to four weeks.
steps.say: Limited psoriasis plaque responds to daily potent corticosteroid ointment zero point one percent betamethasone plus vitamin D analogue calcipotriol fifty micrograms per gram twice daily for four weeks. Eczema needs liberal emollients two hundred fifty grams per week plus moderate potency steroid for flares. Pemphigus starts with systemic corticosteroid one milligram per kilogram daily.

steps.tx: Severe psoriasis with body surface area over ten percent needs methotrexate seven point five to fifteen mg once weekly with folic acid one mg daily, or biologics like **adalimumab** eighty mg then forty mg every other week. Pemphigus adds rituximab one g on day one and day fifteen plus systemic corticosteroid taper over six months.
steps.say: Severe psoriasis with body surface area over ten percent needs methotrexate seven point five milligrams once weekly with folic acid one milligram daily, or biologics like adalimumab eighty milligrams then forty milligrams every other week. Pemphigus care can add rituximab one gram on day one and day fifteen plus a systemic corticosteroid taper.

steps.tx: Psoriasis carries psoriatic arthritis in thirty percent of patients plus higher risk of **metabolic syndrome** with diabetes in forty percent and cardiovascular death at one point five times baseline. Chronic topical steroid misuse causes skin atrophy, striae and secondary glaucoma. Pemphigus without treatment has mortality of seventy-five percent from infection, and long term steroids worsen diabetes and hypertension.

steps.tx: Relapsing course is typical, with **remission rates** of twenty percent per year for plaque psoriasis and mean disease duration of thirty years. Chronic eczema in sixty percent of infants resolves by age five years. Pemphigus requires maintenance **immunosuppression** for two to three years with relapse in fifty percent after stopping therapy.

steps.tx: **High-yield for the exam** memorise the patterns: candle wax phenomenon and Auspitz sign mark psoriasis, Nikolsky sign marks pemphigus, grouped itchy vesicles mark dermatitis herpetiformis, fishnet IgG is pemphigus on direct immunofluorescence and linear IgG is bullous pemphigoid, methotrexate is seven point five to fifteen mg once weekly and rituximab is one g on day one and day fifteen.
